sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD BUT WEAK ANTICYCLONIC PATTERN WILL MAINTAIN LIGHT UPR LVL FLOW OVER MUCH OF THE LWR 48 THROUGH THU...THE EXCEPTIONS BEING NY/NEW ENGLAND AND PARTS OF THE INTERIOR PAC NW/NRN GRT BASIN. TWO JET STREAKS ARE RESPONSIBLE FOR THE ENHANCED FLOW IN THE NORTHEAST...BOTH OF WHICH ARE ROUNDING BASE OF ELONGATING UPR LOW IN CNTRL QUE. THE LEAD IMPULSE...NOW OVER ME/NB...SHOULD CONTINUE E INTO THE CANADIAN MARITIMES TODAY...WHILE UPSTREAM DISTURBANCE...NOW OVER SW QUE...CONTINUES E TO NB BY EVE. IN THE WEST...UPR LOW EXPECTED TO REMAIN NEARLY STNRY OVER NW CA/SW ORE...OR MEANDER JUST OFF THE CST. IN THE PLNS...A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER THE WRN DAKOTAS SHOULD MOVE ESE INTO THE UPR MS VLY BY 12Z THU. ELSEWHERE...WEAK CLOSED CIRCULATIONS EXPECTED TO PERSIST WITH LITTLE OVERALL MOTION OVER SE GA AND THE LWR RIO GRANDE VLY. AT LWR LVLS...COLD FRONT EXTENDING WSW ACROSS NEW ENGLAND AND NY WILL CONTINUE PROGRESSING SE ACROSS THE NERN U.S. TODAY...PRECEDED BY A LEE TROUGH IN THE MID ATLANTIC STATES. THAT PORTION OF THE FRONT EXTENDING WWD FROM OH INTO NRN IA/NEB LIKELY WILL ADVANCE MORE SLOWLY SWD AS A WEAK SFC WAVE FORMS/LINGERS OVER SE NEB OR SW IA.

sections.title: OH ENE INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND/NRN MID ATLANTIC TODAY
sections.text: NUMEROUS CLUSTERS OF STRONG TO POTENTIALLY SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED IN MOIST...VERY WEAKLY CAPPED ENVIRONMENT OF MODERATE WLY FLOW ALONG COLD FRONT OVER PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST TODAY...WHERE STRONG SFC HEATING SHOULD BOOST SBCAPE TO AOA 2500 J/KG. THE BEST CHANCE FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED ACTIVITY WOULD APPEAR TO BE OVER SRN NY/NRN/ERN PA INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND AND NJ...WHERE SMALL BOWING STRUCTURES AND POSSIBLY AN EMBEDDED SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH DMGG WIND MAY OCCUR IN ADDITION TO MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. ASCENT MAY BE ENHANCED BY GLANCING INFLUENCE OF UPR DISTURBANCE CROSSING SRN QUE. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY FORM A BIT FARTHER SE ALONG LEE TROUGH FROM NJ INTO THE NYC AREA AND CT/RI. THE SVR THREAT SHOULD END BY EARLY EVE.

sections.title: MID/LWR MO VLY TO LWR OH VLY TODAY INTO TNGT
sections.text: CORRIDOR OF RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE...FAIRLY STEEP MID LVL LAPSE RATES...AND STRONG SFC HEATING EXPECTED TO YIELD SCTD TO NUMEROUS DIURNALLY ENHANCED STORMS ALONG AND S OF SLOWLY-MOVING FRONT. FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL BE ENHANCED ON WRN END OF THIS CORRIDOR THIS AFTN/EVE BY UPR IMPULSE APPROACHING FROM THE DAKOTAS...WHERE A CLUSTER OR TWO OF STORMS MAY EVOLVE IN IA/ERN NEB. STRONGER MID/UPR LVL FLOW WILL REMAIN N OF REGION...BUT WINDS MAY PROVE SUFFICIENT FOR MULTICELLS AND PERHAPS A WEAK SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH SVR WIND/HAIL.

sections.title: PARTS OF INTERIOR PAC NW/NRN RCKYS THIS AFTN/EVE
sections.text: SFC HEATING AND RELATIVELY COOL MID LVL TEMPS ASSOCIATED WITH NEARBY UPR LOW EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE INSTABILITY /SBCAPE 1000-1500 J PER KG/ OVER PARTS OF INTERIOR ORE/WA AND NRN ID LATER TODAY...WHERE LOW LVL CONVERGENCE WILL EXIST ALONG WEAK THERMAL TROUGH. SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED STORMS GIVEN 30 KT SSWLY 500 MB FLOW. BUT SATELLITE AND MODEL DATA SHOW LITTLE IN THE WAY OF FORCING FOR ASCENT. IN FACT...IT APPEARS THAT SLIGHT HEIGHT RISES MAY OCCUR OVER REGION AS UPR LOW RETROGRESSES SLIGHTLY W. THUS...WHILE A FEW STORMS MAY FORM THAT POSE A RISK FOR SVR HAIL OR LOCALLY DMGG WIND...PROSPECTS FOR SUSTAINED SVR WX ATTM LOOK LOW.

sections.title: TN VLY/GULF CST STATES TODAY
sections.text: COMBINATION OF RICH MOISTURE /PW AROUND 2 INCHES/ AND STRONG SFC HEATING MAY YIELD CLUSTERS OF SLOWLY-MOVING STORMS OVER PARTS OF GULF CST STATES/SOUTHEAST TODAY. DEVELOPMENT LIKELY WILL ONCE AGAIN BE GOVERNED BY AXES OF DEEPER CONFLUENCE ASSOCIATED WITH GA UPR LVL CIRCULATION...AND POSSIBLY BY WEAKER DISTURBANCE FARTHER W ACROSS MS/W TN. WHILE SETUP MAY YIELD A FEW AFTN PULSE STORMS WITH LOCALLY DMGG WIND...NEITHER OBSERVED OR FCST WIND FIELDS APPEAR SUPPORTIVE OF A SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED SVR THREAT. A MINOR EXCEPTION MIGHT BE OVER THE FL PENINSULA...WHERE SOMEWHAT ENHANCED UNIDIRECTIONAL WSW FLOW ON S SIDE OF CIRCULATION MAY YIELD A SMALL CLUSTER OR TWO OF STORMS WITH GUSTY WINDS. ..CORFIDI/ROGERS.. 07/18/2012

sections.title: UPR OH VLY/CNTRL APLCNS NEWD INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: PERUSAL OF 12Z UPR CHARTS/SOUNDINGS DEPICTS A LARGELY UNCAPPED AND VERY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT S OF A CDFNT DRAPED FROM CNTRL NEW ENGLAND SWWD INTO CNTRL NY AND SWRN ONTARIO. BY THE TIME CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES ARE REACHED...MLCAPES WILL BE 1500-2500 J/KG. TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO EVOLVE ALONG MANY FEATURES THIS AFTN. PRIMARY FOCUS FOR STORMS WILL BE ALONG THE SWD MOVING CDFNT...HIGHER TERRAIN CIRCULATIONS AND LEE TROUGH IN THE COASTAL PLAINS. STRONGER DEEP-LAYER FLOW WILL REMAIN GENERALLY N OF THE MASON DIXON LINE...AND IN PARTICULAR...UPSTATE NY AND NEW ENGLAND. HERE...REGION WILL RESIDE ALONG A GLANCING INFLUENCE OF A MID-LEVEL WAVE PASSING THROUGH ONTARIO/QUEBEC...BOOSTING DEEP LAYER SHEAR INTO THE 35-40 KT RANGE. BEST CHANCE FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED ACTIVITY WOULD APPEAR TO BE OVER SRN NY/NRN/ERN PA INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND AND NJ. CONVECTIVE MODE WILL FEATURE SMALL BOWING STRUCTURES AND POSSIBLY AN EMBEDDED SUPERCELL OR TWO WITH DMGG WINDS AND MARGINALLY SVR HAIL LIKELY. SVR THREATS SHOULD END BY EARLY EVE.

sections.title: 20Z OUTLOOK UPDATE
sections.text: CHANGES TO THE 1630Z OUTLOOK ARE GENERALLY MINOR...AND MOSTLY TO ACCOUNT FOR ONGOING CONVECTIVE TRENDS ACROSS PARTS OF THE NORTHEAST. CONSIDERABLE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY IS ALREADY ONGOING ACROSS SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND AND THE NORTHERN MID ATLANTIC COAST STATES INTO THE OHIO VALLEY...ALONG/AHEAD OF THE SOUTHWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT. LOW-LEVEL SHEAR MAY REMAIN STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT ACROSS THE LOWER HUDSON VALLEY AND LONG ISLAND INTO SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...BUT THIS POTENTIAL...IN ADDITION TO THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL PROBABLY WILL DIMINISH BY 22-23Z WITH STRONGER CONVECTION ADVANCING OFFSHORE. THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT MAY CONTINUE INTO EARLY EVENING ALONG AND SOUTHEAST OF THE URBAN CORRIDOR FROM WASHINGTON D.C. AND BALTIMORE INTO SOUTHERN NEW JERSEY...WHERE VIGOROUS STORMS ARE JUST NOW BEGINNING TO DEVELOP INTO THE HOT AND HUMID ENVIRONMENT ALONG THE PRE-FRONTAL SURFACE TROUGH. ELSEWHERE...PLEASE REFER TO THE PRIOR DISCUSSION APPENDED BELOW... AND THE LATEST SPC WATCHES AND MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR MORE SPECIFIC INFORMATION CONCERNING ONGOING OR MORE IMMINENT CONVECTIVE THREATS. ..KERR.. 07/18/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1124 AM CDT WED J

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON...A SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED FOR ALL OR MUCH OF PA/NJ AND SOUTHERN PORTIONS OF NY/NEW ENGLAND BY 15Z-16Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FRONTAL BOUNDARY IS ANALYZED THIS MORNING FROM LAKE ERIE VICINITY EAST-NORTHEASTWARD TO EAST-CENTRAL NY/CENTRAL NEW ENGLAND. THE AIRMASS TO THE SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY IS STEADILY WARMING AMID RELATIVELY CLOUD-FREE SKIES PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY...WITH DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE UPPER 60S/LOWER 70S F. INCIPIENT TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS ALREADY OCCURRING ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL PA AS OF 14Z. ALONG/SOUTH OF THE COLD FRONT...WITH ADDITIONAL AIDE OF NEAR-COASTAL/PRE-FRONTAL SURFACE TROUGH DEVELOPMENT...IT SEEMS VERY LIKELY THAT SCATTERED TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP/INCREASE INTO EARLY/MID AFTERNOON ACROSS MUCH OF THE REST OF PA/NJ AND SOUTHERN NY/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. BASED ON 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS SUCH AS BUF/ALB/OKX...MUCH OF THE REGION RESIDES ON THE SOUTHERN FRINGE OF MODERATE WESTERLIES ALOFT /30-50 KT 3-6 KM/ AND COINCIDES WITH A PLUME OF RELATIVELY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES /ESPECIALLY SOUTHEAST NY AND SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND/. WITH STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND A LIKELIHOOD OF 2000-3500 J/KG SBCAPE SOUTH OF THE COLD FRONT...STRONG/SEVERE TSTM DEVELOPMENT AND INTENSIFICATION IS LIKELY THROUGH EARLY/MID AFTERNOON. SUFFICIENT VERTICAL SHEAR EXISTS FOR ORGANIZED/SUSTAINED MULTICELLS...AND THIS WILL ESPECIALLY BE THE CASE FOR AREAS SUCH AS NORTHEAST PA/NORTHERN NJ INTO FAR SOUTHEAST NY/SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. HERE...SOMEWHAT STRONGER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT BOWING STRUCTURES/SOME SUPERCELLS...WITH DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO BEING POSSIBLE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DMGG WIND AND HAIL WILL BECOME POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON...WITH A LOOSELY ORGANIZED CLUSTER PROGRESSING SEWD WITH TIME. AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE ONGOING ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS CNTRL/SRN MN HAS LEFT AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...LOCATED JUST E OF FARIBAULT MN AND EXTENDING SWWD THROUGH ALGONA IA. TWO SEPARATE BOUNDARIES ARE ALSO ORIENTED NEAR MN/WI/IA/IL...INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO A DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE ACROSS CNTRL WI...AND A COLD FRONT ORIENTED ACROSS NRN IA AND IL. WITH AMBIENT MOISTURE AND SURFACE TEMPERATURES QUICKLY WARMING INTO THE 80S TO LOWER 90S F...MODIFIED MPX AND DVN SOUNDINGS INDICATE ANY REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL BE ERODED SHORTLY. AS SUCH...EXPECT A GENERAL INCREASE IN CONVECTION...PARTICULARLY NEAR THE OUTFLOW/COLD FRONT INTERSECTION ACROSS SERN MN AND NERN IA. ALTHOUGH DEEP LAYER SHEAR IS WEAK...AS THE EVOLVING CLUSTER OF STORMS PROGRESSES TOWARDS THE GREAT LAKES...IT WILL ENCOUNTER LIGHT-MODEST NWLY FLOW ALOFT...SUPPORTING MULTICELLULAR CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF DMGG WIND AND HAIL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED BOUTS OF DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL WILL INCREASE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PORTIONS OF INDIANA/MUCH OF OH INTO WESTERN PA/NORTHERN WV.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE AIRMASS TO THE SOUTH OF A FRONTAL BOUNDARY...THAT EXTENDS ROUGHLY WEST-EAST FROM SOUTHERN LAKE MI VICINITY TO NEAR LAKE ERIE...HAS BECOME MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE ACROSS BROAD PORTIONS OF INDIANA/MUCH OF OH AS WELL AS ADJACENT PARTS OF WESTERN PA/NORTHERN WV. AS SURFACE TEMPERATURES CONTINUE TO CLIMB INTO/THROUGH THE 90S F...RELATIVELY STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND AMPLE PRECIPITABLE WATER ENVIRONMENT ARE SUPPORTING SBCAPE VALUES TO AS HIGH AS 2500-3500 J/KG...AS PER MODIFICATIONS TO 12Z OBSERVED SOUNDINGS FROM LINCOLN IL/WILMINGTON OH/PITTSBURGH PA. WHILE STRONG UPDRAFTS/DOWNDRAFTS WILL BE POSSIBLE GIVEN THE DEGREE OF BUOYANCY/LAPSE RATES...WEAK VERTICAL SHEAR /PER WSR-88D VWPS AND AFOREMENTIONED 12Z SOUNDINGS/ MAY TEND TO LIMIT THE OVERALL ORGANIZATION. NONETHELESS...MICROBURSTS/DAMAGING WINDS...ALONG WITH SOME HAIL...WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH PULSE/MULTICELLULAR STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. A SEVERE TSTM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED THIS AFTERNOON FOR PORTIONS OF THE REGION...ESPECIALLY IF STORMS BEGIN TO CONGEAL/ORGANIZE TO A DEGREE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 490 CONTINUES UNTIL 01Z ACROSS PORTIONS OF CT/MA/RI AND NORTHEAST NJ/SOUTHEAST NY INCLUDING THE NYC METRO AREA. PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT INCLUDES DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL...ALTHOUGH A BRIEF TORNADO THREAT MAY EXIST ACROSS PORTIONS OF COASTAL NEW ENGLAND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL BROKEN BANDS OF STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS CONTINUE TO STEADILY INCREASE/SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS SOUTHERN/EASTERN MA AND SOUTHEAST NY/CT/RI THIS AFTERNOON. A 55 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT KBDL/HARTFORD-BRADLEY CT. WITH A HOT THERMAL AXIS EXTENDING NORTHEASTWARD FROM NJ INTO SOUTHWEST NEW ENGLAND /100F IN A FEW AREAS/...THE AMBIENT AIRMASS REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE NEAR/SOUTH OF EVOLVING STORMS...WITH MLCAPE AS MUCH AS 2000-3000 J/KG ACROSS FAR SOUTHEAST NY AND CT/RI/SOUTHERN MA. LATEST WSR-88D VWP DATA FROM TAUNTON/KBOX REFLECTS THE MODERATELY STRONG VERTICAL SHEAR THAT ESPECIALLY RESIDES ACROSS SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...WITH 35-40 KT WESTERLIES SAMPLED BETWEEN 3-5 KM. MULTICELLS/SMALL BOWING SEGMENTS WILL REMAIN COMMON ACROSS THE REGION. THAT SAID...A FEW SUPERCELLS WILL BE MOST PROBABLE ACROSS SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND. SUCH SUPERCELL /AND ENHANCED SEVERE HAIL AND SOME TORNADO RISK/ POTENTIAL WILL BE ESPECIALLY FOCUSED 1/ TO THE EAST OF A HEAT-AIDED SURFACE LOW ACROSS SOUTHWEST NEW ENGLAND OR MORE SO 2/ TIED TO EXPECTED STORM/SEA BREEZE INTERACTIONS ACROSS SOUTHEAST MA AND PERHAPS RI/CT/LONG ISLAND VICINITIES. ..GUYER.. 07/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITHIN SEVERE TSTM WATCH 491...DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL POTENTIAL CONTINUES ESPECIALLY FROM NORTHERN VA AND CENTRAL/EASTERN MD INTO FAR EASTERN PA AND NJ. ADDITIONAL/MORE ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS WILL ALSO CONTINUE TO OCCUR ACROSS PORTIONS OF WESTERN/SOUTHERN VA...ALTHOUGH AN ADDITIONAL WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY EXPECTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WITHIN A NORTHEAST-SOUTHWEST ORIENTED AXIS...SCATTERED TSTMS HAVE TENDED TO CONSOLIDATE INTO SEVERAL EASTWARD-MOVING BANDS ACROSS NORTHERN NJ/FAR EASTERN PA AND FAR NORTHERN VA/CENTRAL MD AS OF 1930Z. A 51 KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY /1929Z/ MEASURED VIA THE LANCASTER PA ASOS. DAMAGING WINDS/SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN A DISTINCT POSSIBILITY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NJ/FAR SOUTHEAST PA AND NORTHERN VA AND CENTRAL/EASTERN MD...AS A LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES TO SPREAD EASTWARD ACROSS A INSTABILITY AXIS /NEAR A SURFACE TROUGH/ CHARACTERIZED BY 2500-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. OTHER MORE ISOLATED SEVERE TSTMS WILL ALSO REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS AREAS PORTIONS OF SOUTHWEST/SOUTHERN VA...WITH DOWNBURSTS/MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL POSSIBLE. ..GUYER.. 07/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE COVERAGE IS INCREASING ACROSS SERN MN AND NERN IA...AND MAY EVOLVE INTO AN ESEWD PROGRESSING MCS CAPABLE OF DMGG WINDS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 20Z WV IMAGERY INDICATES A SUBTLE UPPER TROUGH...WITH IMPLIED FORCING FOR ASCENT AND MODEST WLY FLOW ALOFT PROGRESSING INTO MN/IA ATTM. IN COMBINATION WITH A WEAK MCV AND REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY NOTED NEAR THE N CNTRL IA/S CNTRL MN BORDER...CONVECTION IS BEGINNING TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY OVER SERN MN/NERN IA. AMBIENT MOISTURE AND DIURNAL HEATING HAVE SUPPORTED TEMPERATURES IN THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 100 F S OF THE STATIONARY FRONT IN ADVANCE OF THE ONGOING COMPLEX. WITH THE ASSOCIATED STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...THERE IS SOME POTENTIAL THAT AN ORGANIZED COLD POOL COULD DEVELOP...WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT OF DMGG WINDS ACROSS THE WW AREA. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS POSSIBLE ALONG THE COLD FRONT ACROSS SRN WI...WHERE CU FIELDS HAVE BECOME INCREASINGLY AGITATED. ..HURLBUT.. 07/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE TSTM WATCH 492 CONTINUES UNTIL 01Z...WITH POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS/SOME SEVERE HAIL CONTINUING ESPECIALLY ACROSS NORTHWEST/DOWNSTATE INDIANA INTO THE SOUTHERN HALF OF OH AND ADJACENT PARTS OF WV/PA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALONG AND MORE SO SOUTH OF A SYNOPTIC FRONTAL BOUNDARY...SEVERAL CORRIDORS OF SCATTERED TSTMS CONTINUE TO OCCUR/SPREAD GENERALLY SOUTHEASTWARD THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NORTHWEST/MUCH OF DOWNSTATE INDIANA INTO CENTRAL/SOUTHERN OH AND ADJACENT WV/SOUTHWEST PA. WHILE THE BOUNDARY LAYER HAS BEEN CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED IN AREAS SUCH AS NORTHWEST/NORTH-CENTRAL OH...THE AIRMASS REMAINS WARM/MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE ALONG/SOUTH OF EXISTING CONVECTION. BOUTS OF DAMAGING WINDS ALONG WITH SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INTO EARLY EVENING. ..GUYER.. 07/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WIND/SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL CONTINUES LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING MAINLY ACROSS NYC METRO/LONG ISLAND VICINITY AND NEAR-COASTAL SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO STEADILY SPREAD EASTWARD LATE THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING MAINLY ACROSS NYC METRO/LONG ISLAND VICINITY AND NEAR-COASTAL SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND...WITH DAMAGING WIND/SOME HAIL AND LOCALLY HEAVY RAINFALL IN THESE AREAS. THE AIRMASS HAS BEEN CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED IN THE IMMEDIATE WAKE /NORTH/ OF THIS CONVECTION...ALTHOUGH SOME STRONG/SEVERE TSTM REDEVELOPMENT CANNOT BE RULED OUT /NORTHWARD/ NEAR THE FRONT WHERE THE AIRMASS MAY RECOVER TO A DEGREE ACROSS PORTIONS OF FAR SOUTHEAST NY/SOUTHWEST NEW ENGLAND. ..GUYER.. 07/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE FOR A FEW MORE HOURS ACROSS SE WI...NE IL AND MAY DEVELOP ACROSS SRN LAKE MI AND NW IND. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. THE WATCH MAY NEED A LOCAL EXTENSION IN TIME IN THE CHICAGO AND MILWAUKEE AREAS BEYOND THE 01Z EXPIRATION OR A SMALL NEW WATCH WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE ISSUED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BOWING LINE SEGMENT IN SRN WI IS CURRENTLY LOCATED ALONG A NARROW AXIS OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS MLCAPE VALUES AROUND 1500 J/KG IN SRN WI. THE MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDS SEWD ACROSS NE IL INTO NW IND. THE EXPECTED TRACK OF THE LINE SEGMENT IS EXPECTED TO BE ON THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WITH THE LINE MOVING ESEWD ACROSS SRN LAKE MI. IF THIS HAPPENS...THE LINE SEGMENT COULD WEAKEN AS IT ENCOUNTERS THE MORE STABLE AIRMASS OVER THE LAKE. IF THE LINE CAN TURN MORE TO THE RIGHT...THEN A CONTINUING SEVERE THREAT THIS EVENING WOULD BE MORE PROBABLE WITH A WW EXTENSION LIKELY NEEDED ACROSS PARTS OF NE IL AND NW IND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY CONTINUE FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO IN NE ORE. LARGE HAIL AND ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. THE ACTIVITY SHOULD REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FEW CELLS HAVE DEVELOPED JUST TO THE SOUTHEAST OF PENDLETON WITHIN A POCKET OF MODERATE INSTABILITY ANALYZED BY MESOANALYSIS. MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED AROUND 2000 J/KG AND WITH 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 25 TO 35 KT. THIS ALONG WITH 850 TO 500 MB LAPSE RATES AROUND 8.5 C/KM SHOULD CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A MARGINAL SUPERCELL ENVIRONMENT WITH A POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY THIS EVENING. AN ISOLATED WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY ALSO EXIST. THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR TWO BUT SHOULD DIMINISH DURING THE MID-EVENING AS SFC TEMPS COOL ACROSS THE REGION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY MOVE INTO NRN IND AND SW LOWER MI LATE THIS EVENING. THE MAIN THREATS SHOULD BE WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED DUE TO THE ISOLATED NATURE OF THE THREAT AND WEAK INSTABILITY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A FRAGMENTED LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING FROM SRN LAKE MI EXTENDING SSWWD INTO FAR NE IL LOCATED ON THE NERN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY. THE STORMS ARE JUST AHEAD OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH EVIDENT ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY WITH A BAND OF STRONG LARGE-SCALE ASCENT MOVING THROUGH THE CHICAGO AREA ATTM. IN SPITE OF THE LIFT...INSTABILITY IS WEAK ACROSS SW LOWER MI AND NRN IND WHERE THE MCS IS EXPECTED TO TRACK. FOR THIS REASON...A WEAKENING TREND SHOULD OCCUR WITH THE CONVECTION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...BEFORE THE LINE WEAKENS...STRONG OUTFLOW GUSTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE COULD PRODUCE A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR BUT SHOULD BE THE LESSER OF THE TWO THREATS. ..BROYLES.. 07/19/2012
